title: Salam Kissan won Best Digital Campaign Award at PDA 2020 | Sarsabz | Overview
description: Salam Kissan- BDigital's objectively crafted campaign highlighting Sarsabz (Fatima Fertilizers) thoughtful narrative to recognize the farmers of Pakistan, gets awarded as the "Best Digital Campaign" of the year at Pakistan Digital Awards 2020.  The beauty of the campaign lies in how it reached out to more than 9.9M people across multiple platforms (i.e. Facebook, YouTube, Twitter plus Instagram) & all segments of society to evoke the sentiments of gratitude for the farmers and reminded everyone to stop for a moment to look around and realize the impact of Kissan’s contribution to our everyday

title: Highest Cotton Yield in Punjab - Rabia Sultan's Testimonial
description: Rabia Sultan, a progressive farmer from Pakistan and president of Farmer Association of Pakistan tells us her story of becoming a farmer. Sarsabz Fertilizer has stood beside her throughout her journey and has managed to give her more than 10% increase in yield for cotton compared to regular fertilizers!
